Here’s how we run every project.

Fully Managed From Start to Finish
Design, budgeting, scheduling, and construction handled under one team. One point of contact. No coordination gaps.

Designers Who Understand the Process
Design is integrated into the process when required. No disconnect between designer and builder.

Start Strong. Finish Strong.
Projects are planned upfront so they move efficiently.

Pre-Construction System
Before construction begins, we define the scope, budget, selections and schedule to reduce delays.

Service-Driven Team
Professional, vetted team from office to field. Consistent communication and client experience.

Any Size Project. Same Standard.
From $10K renovations to multi-million dollar projects, same level of execution and attention.

The kitchen remains the heart of every home, a space for gathering loved ones. Modern kitchens go beyond mere cooking areas, blending practicality and aesthetics. Optimal kitchen design balances function and style to fulfill diverse needs. Palmhouse specializes in reshaping your current kitchen into a tailored, personalized area that suits your home life perfectly. For homeowners focused on cabinetry, custom kitchen cabinets are available as a stand-alone service tailored to your existing kitchen footprint.

Built for Discerning Homeowners

Clear communication

Concierge-level design and construction, managed from start to finish.

For focused project types and private communities, Palmhouse also supports kitchen remodeling in Delray Beach, luxury remodeling in Mirasol, luxury remodeling in PGA National, luxury remodeling in Old Palm, luxury remodeling in BallenIsles, luxury remodeling on PGA Boulevard, and luxury home remodeling in Palm Beach Gardens.

About Palmhouse

Since 2005, our company has thrived on a foundation of unwavering dedication to our clients’ unique visions. We don’t just remodel spaces; we curate transformative experiences. Our journey began with a promise to listen, understand, and craft solutions aligned with individual needs, budgets, and aspirations. Our interior design services run alongside every renovation we complete, with floor plans, material palettes, and finish selections handled in-house.

We’ve built a team renowned for their ingenuity, led by seasoned project managers, skilled craftsmen, and talented interior designers. From minor renovations to complete home transformations, our proactive approach and commitment to on-time delivery have set us apart. Our hallmark is the personalized touch and a keen sense of client needs, ensuring a seamless and thoughtful process from inception to completion.

At our core, we value integrity, professionalism, and ethical conduct. We maintain pristine job sites, prioritizing our clients’ homes and offering a concierge-like service that minimizes disruptions. We cherish enduring relationships, both with our clients and within the community we call home. Giving back and investing in our team’s growth and development is integral to our ethos.

Our Commitment to Excellence

Our clients seek more than a mere renovation; they desire a partner who understands their unique vision and executes it flawlessly. They appreciate a meticulous approach, where attention to detail and craftsmanship reign supreme. They value open communication, trust, and a collaborative journey toward their dream space. Our clients appreciate the significance of a tailored, personalized experience and share our commitment to fostering enduring relationships. In essence, our company’s ethos revolves around delivering exceptional craftsmanship, personalized service, and fostering lasting connections within the community we serve. Beyond whole-home renovations, our team also provides bathtub installation services, shower installation services, interior and exterior painting, and custom cabinetry for kitchens, baths, and bespoke storage throughout the home.

Our commitment to sustainability and energy efficiency. We prioritize the application of focus on energy standards and building practices in all our projects.

Strong partnerships built on honesty and open communication. We value your input at every stage and ensure transparent communication channels so that together we can achieve remarkable results.

Dream, Design & Build with Palmhouse

As a licensed general contractor in Florida, our team carries the credentials, insurance, and permitting expertise needed for any size project across Palm Beach County.Palmhouse Design specializes in building and renovating homes, emphasizing lasting client relationships. Our business thrives on honesty and integrity, and trust in every project.

We value time and budget constraints, leveraging our expertise and client-centric design/build approach to consistently exceed expectations. Our projects are delivered within agreed timelines and budgets.

As a trusted Design Build Firm in South Florida, we consistently deliver high-quality projects promptly. Serving a diverse clientele, including residential, commercial, retail, business, and institutional sectors, we specialize in a variety of custom renovation projects.

Communities We Serve

We work throughout Palm Beach County, including Palm Beach Island, Palm Beach Gardens, and North Palm Beach, where high-end homes often require careful planning, refined finishes, and local construction experience.

From oceanfront estates to gated golf and waterfront communities, our team understands the review requirements, access coordination, and finish expectations that come with renovating in these neighborhoods.

Just wanting to get some direction or design advice? With our virtual design consult we’re ready to help you with any design-related questions you have for your home. This could include general furniture guidance, paint colors, advice for hard and soft finishes, or anything else you’re wanting help with.

Specifics

Please specify your list of needs for this space on the needs and wants section of the form that will need to be filled out after you purchase this package. The virtual design consultation will be conducted over a

Zoom Meeting
Google Hangout 
Facetime

and will last 1 hour. The consultation will be coordinated and conducted by an experienced member of the Palmhouse Design and Build team.  It would be helpful for you to have a clear list of topics/questions organized in preparation for the consult so we can use your time as effectively as we can.

Out of State Clients

Our clients range from local homeowners to snowbirds and people who own vacation properties in Florida but live outside of the state sometimes the country, this has help us formulated a flexible system were we have been able to completed full house remodel meeting with our clients virtually using

Facetime
Google Meet
Zoom
email 
text

Our designers are focus on making the process as simple as possible while exceeding our clients expectations no matter where you are located.

Project Form

Fill out a Project Form with details regarding your project. You will be contacted to schedule an in-depth design consultation which will take place over the phone. In preparation for the phone consultation, we will ask you to provide measurements and photos of your existing space, as well as 2-3 inspiration images for your project if you have any, if not no worries. During your call, a Palmhouse designer will go over your needs in detail and make sure we are all on the same page. Depending on the scope of your project, we can work with existing furniture, already in your space or come up with a completely new space, but for remodeling we will design the space of your dreams , from a kitchen remodel to a full house remodel.

Following the in-depth phone call, the design phase will begin once we sign a retainer agreement!

As a full-service design | build firm we have created a structure and a process that allows you to still live life in the middle of a difficult disruption. We are with you every step of the way, from inspiration to completion. Every project’s team consists of a Design Consultant, Interior Designer, and Project Manager, with the full support of our office and production staff.

You have an idea

Have an idea but unsure about feasibility, cost, and time? Let's explore the possibilities together with Palmhouse Design Remodelers.Transform your concept into reality with our expert guidance.

Contact Us

Get in touch with Palmhouse Design! You can fill out their contact form by Click here or call them at 561-831-4170. They are ready to answer your questions and connect you with a Design Consultant for your first appointment!

Initial Consultation

Meet with our Design Consultant for a complimentary consultation at your home. We'll discuss your goals, assess budgets, and propose solutions. Get started on transforming your space with Palmhouse Design Remodelers!

Design & Planning Phase

Once you’ve decided to move forward and take this exciting step, your Design Consultant and Interior Designer will take detailed photographs and measurements of your home and begin designing an accurate plan. They will work in tandem to create a custom solution for you, and the way you live in your home.

Design Presentation & Construction Agreement

During your first design presentation, you will be able to see custom plans designed to address your goals and wishes. Floor plans, elevations, and digital renderings will help you visualize and understand your new space, while the specifications will provide a complete cost analysis of the proposed plan. Your Interior Designer will also have examples of materials that have been spec’d for your project. We will make any necessary revisions to the plans and/or specifications based on your feedback. Once the final changes have been approved and you feel comfortable (and hopefully, super excited) about the plan, we move into a Construction Agreement. This agreement maps out the timeline, payment schedule, approved specifications, drawings and final budget for the project.

The Selections Phase

During this exciting phase, you will work closely with your Interior Designer, whose guidance and expertise will give you the confidence to make all of your selections and material decisions needed to finalize the details of your project. Your selections meetings will take place in our Design Studio, exclusive to our clients. While you’re finalizing your design details, our internal team will be hard at work ordering your selected products and preparing construction ready documents to acquire any required HOA approvals, and/or permits needed to start your project.

The Construction Phase

Once your selections are made, materials have been ordered, and any permits needed have been approved, we can begin construction and start to turn your plans into a reality. You will get a weekly schedule of what will be happening in your home, as well as a detailed timeline for the project. Your Design Consultant, Interior Designer, and Project Manager will be there for you every step of the way to oversee your project through its completion. Throughout the construction phase, you will work directly with our general contracting team — the same group that planned, permitted, and scheduled your project from day one.

The Finish Line

Your final beauty shows its face, and your design fee gets credited towards your final bill. Our services don’t stop there – our Two (2) year warranty will give you the peace of mind that we stand behind our work.

Timeline

Our process is the same whether the project is a single bathroom in Jupiter or luxury renovations on Palm Beach Island — the team, structure, and standards do not change. The following indicates the average timeframes you can expect for a remodeling project in your home. These timeframes can vary greatly depending on the size and scope of your project, as well as many other key components that can play into them. During the course of these stages, there are also several integral workings going on “behind the scenes”, such as pulling permits, getting variances when needed, and ordering the materials for your project. We do our best to create a structure and process that allows you to still live life in your home – in the middle of a difficult disruption. For homeowners taking on a whole-house renovation, the timeline expectations and structure are the same — just on a longer schedule with more phases of work.

Construction Phase

We have completed home renovations in Palm Beach Gardens across BallenIsles, Mirasol, and PGA National using this same organized process. The same approach guides our home renovations in North Palm Beach, where projects often require waterfront construction planning and access coordination.

Why You Should Consider Palmhouse Design:

External elements, ranging from weather conditions to sunlight and pests, can cause deterioration to your home's exterior over time. Routine maintenance is crucial to prevent damage. In the absence of regular upkeep, Palmhouse Design becomes essential. This service addresses any damaged areas, ensuring protection against issues like water damage and mold growth.

To Update Your Home

A change of pace is often welcome, and a home exterior remodel can provide just that. It allows you to give your home a fresh, new look that aligns with your style preferences. Need more than a refresh? Our team also builds each home addition with the same care. From the foundation to the final coat, we handle the whole project under one roof. The new space blends with the rest of your home.
